notes: Corpus is gitignored (data/legalbenchrag/) and not redistributed; corpus_sha256 pins the exact file used. Wall time is machine-dependent. This measures clause segmentation (span containment and enclosure tightness), NOT query-answering accuracy, and NOT deal-point accuracy: there is no M&A playbook among the 23 named modes, so no per-category or recall number comparable to the product-mode table can be produced without authoring one. Mean token-F1 is taken over every evaluated span with a non-contained span counted as 0.
